verdict.rationale: DBOS documents several public programmatic surfaces. Conductor's workflow, queue and schedule management is exposed over an OpenAPI-described HTTP API covering search, cancel, fork, metrics, audit logs and API keys, and the dbosctl CLI wraps the same API. The library also documents DBOSClient for external code and a CLI that lists workflows as JSON. A user building their own TUI for managing their DBOS application loosely suggests this works in practice. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the guessed docs-domain paths, but that only shows the spec isn't at those URLs; it doesn't contradict the API. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec file (probe paths 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of the Conductor HTTP API.
